extracted.name: Homemade Irish (Whiskey) Cream
extracted.description: You'll need vanilla and almond extracts, instant coffee granules, and, of course, Irish whiskey to make this favorite.
instruction_lines: Blend the Irish whiskey, heavy cream, sweetened condensed milk, instant coffee granules, vanilla extract, and almond extract in a blender on high until frothy, 20 to 30 seconds. Chill 24 hours before using.
